function.arguments:
{"query":"WITH files AS (
  SELECT
    url,
    content
  FROM WEB_FETCH(
    'https://planet4589.org/space/gcat/tsv/derived/launchlog.tsv',
    'https://planet4589.org/space/gcat/tsv/tables/lp.tsv'
  )
), launch_lines AS (
  SELECT
    UNNEST(string_split(content, chr(10))) AS line
  FROM files
  WHERE url LIKE '%launchlog.tsv'
), launch_pieces AS (
  SELECT
    trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 1)) AS launch_id,
    trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 2)) AS launch_date,
    trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 13)) AS site_code,
    trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 14)) AS pad_code,
    trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 18)) AS bloc_code,
    trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 19)) AS launch_code
  FROM launch_lines
  WHERE line NOT LIKE '#%'
), launches AS (
  SELECT
    launch_id,
    min(launch_date) AS launch_date,
    min(site_code) AS site_code,
    min(pad_code) AS pad_code,
    min(bloc_code) AS bloc_code
  FROM launch_pieces
  WHERE TRY_CAST(substr(launch_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1957 AND 2026
    AND (launch_code LIKE 'O%' OR launch_code LIKE 'D%')
  GROUP BY launch_id
), pad_lines AS (
  SELECT
    UNNEST(string_split(content, chr(10))) AS line
  FROM files
  WHERE url LIKE '%lp.tsv'
), pads AS (
  SELECT
    trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 1)) AS site_code,
    trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 7)) AS stop_date,
    nullif(trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 8)), '-') AS short_name,
    nullif(trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 10)), '-') AS location,
    TRY_CAST(trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 11)) AS DOUBLE) AS longitude,
    TRY_CAST(trim(split_part(line, chr(9), 12)) AS DOUBLE) AS latitude
  FROM pad_lines
  WHERE line NOT LIKE '#%'
), sites AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    coalesce(mode(location), mode(short_name), site_code) AS site_name,
    median(longitude) AS longitude,
    median(latitude) AS latitude,
    CASE
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN stop_date = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Active'
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN stop_date NOT IN ('-', '', '*') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Inactive'
      ELSE 'Status unclear'
    END AS active_now
  FROM pads
  GROUP BY site_code
), detailed AS (
  SELECT
    TRY_CAST(substr(l.launch_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    l.launch_id,
    l.launch_date,
    l.site_code,
    l.pad_code,
    coalesce(s.site_name, l.site_code) AS site_name,
    s.longitude,
    s.latitude,
    CASE l.bloc_code
      WHEN 'SU' THEN 'Soviet Union'
      WHEN 'US' THEN 'United States'
      WHEN 'RU' THEN 'Russia'
      WHEN 'CN' THEN 'China'
      WHEN 'IN' THEN 'India'
      WHEN 'JP' THEN 'Japan'
      WHEN 'FR' THEN 'France'
      WHEN 'EU' THEN 'Europe / ESA'
      WHEN 'GB' THEN 'United Kingdom'
      WHEN 'IT' THEN 'Italy'
      WHEN 'IL' THEN 'Israel'
      WHEN 'IR' THEN 'Iran'
      WHEN 'KP' THEN 'North Korea'
      WHEN 'KR' THEN 'South Korea'
      WHEN 'UA' THEN 'Ukraine'
      WHEN 'KZ' THEN 'Kazakhstan'
      WHEN 'NZ' THEN 'New Zealand'
      WHEN 'BR' THEN 'Brazil'
      WHEN 'AU' THEN 'Australia'
      WHEN 'CA' THEN 'Canada'
      WHEN 'DE' THEN 'Germany'
      WHEN 'ES' THEN 'Spain'
      WHEN 'AR' THEN 'Argentina'
      ELSE nullif(l.bloc_code, '-')
    END AS operating_bloc,
    coalesce(s.active_now, 'Status unclear') AS site_active_now
  FROM launches l
  LEFT JOIN sites s USING (site_code)
)
SELECT
  year,
  site_code,
  site_name AS launch_site,
  pad_code AS launch_pad,
  operating_bloc,
  site_active_now,
  longitude,
  latitude,
  count(*) AS launch_count,
  string_agg(launch_id, ', ' ORDER BY launch_date, launch_id) AS launch_ids,
  'https://planet4589.org/space/gcat/tsv/derived/launchlog.tsv' AS launch_source_url,
  'https://planet4589.org/space/gcat/tsv/tables/lp.tsv' AS site_status_source_url
FROM detailed
GROUP BY
  year,
  site_code,
  site_name,
  pad_code,
  operating_bloc,
  site_active_now,
  longitude,
  latitude
ORDER BY
  year,
  launch_site,
  launch_pad,
  operating_bloc","show_preview":false}
